parameters.name: Name
parameters.description:
The name of the template.

- The name can be up to 128 bytes in length.
- The name must be encoded in UTF-8.

parameters.name: TemplateConfig
parameters.description: The configurations of the snapshot template in JSON format. For more information about the parameter structure, see [SnapshotTemplateConfig](~~98618~~).

parameters.name: VodTemplateId
parameters.description: The ID of the snapshot template.
